standard_prerequisites.name: The fibre of the strict henselization at a prime is a product of residue fields of the primes over the prime below
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the product of formal fibres into the single tensor product where the completion of the strict henselization appears.

standard_prerequisites.name: The completion of the henselization is formally smooth over the completion of the ring, hence regular
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Lemma \ref{lemma-henselization-noetherian} and Proposition \ref{proposition-fs-regular}, cited at proof lines 13180-13183
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the base change of property P along the completion available through condition (C).

standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers property P from the residue field of the prime below to the residue field of the prime.

core_obligations: Quote the henselization case and reduce the strict henselization case to the formal fibre condition (proof lines 13162-13167).
Choose a prime of the strict henselization and list the primes over the prime below, using the fibre computation (proof lines 13168-13174).
Rewrite the product of the formal fibres as a single tensor product over the completion (proof lines 13175-13179).

Use formal smoothness of the completion of the henselization over the completion of the ring to get regularity, and condition (C) with the P-ring hypothesis to get property P before localising (proof lines 13180-13186).
Apply condition (B) with the decomposition and then condition (E) with separability of the residue field extension to reach the formal fibre of the strict henselization (proof lines 13187-13195).
proof_roadmap: Henselization case and reduction of the strict case (proof lines 13162-13167).
Fibre decomposition at a prime (proof lines 13168-13179).
Regularity of the completion map and conditions (C), (B), (E) (proof lines 13180-13195).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the henselization and the strict henselization of a Noetherian local P-ring remain P-rings. The henselization case is quoted from the companion result for the henselian pair, and the strict henselization case is reduced to the condition on formal fibres. The computation then proceeds at a prime of the strict henselization: the fibre of the strict henselization over the residue field of the prime below is a product of residue fields by the fibre computation, which turns the product of the formal fibres at the primes over that residue field into a single tensor product, and the map from the completion of the ring to the completion of its strict henselization is formally smooth, hence regular, so the permanence conditions (C), (B) and (E) give property P for the fibre of the strict henselization at the chosen prime.
